title: Low-sodium/high-glucose co-occurrence did not establish incremental processing-speed prediction across two NHANES samples
abstract: A fixed low-sodium/high-glucose hinge did not establish incremental DSST prediction beyond flexible conventional blood chemistry, calculated osmolarity and demographic factors. Source2011–2012(n=1289)CV MSE gain was -0.7627; separate2013–2014(n=1504)weighted MSE gain was 0.0214 score²(400 source+target PSU-refit95%interval -2.7920 to 1.0332). These are separately sampled releases in one program,not untouched external-cohort confirmation;the negative result is not equivalence.
